page1.heading: Who is he?
page1.subheading: Adnan Abdullah is a self-made industrialist. He likely inherited the land or initial business from his father, expanded it during the construction boom, and now supplies major contractors, municipalities, and giga-projects.

page2.heading: What He Wants
page2.subheading:
• Respect & Legacy: He is focused on ensuring his sons are prepared to take over the business.
• Stability: He requires clear regulatory roadmaps to ensure operational consistency as he navigates the decarbonization process.
• Reputation: As a vital national contributor, he seeks to balance his industrial output with responsible decarbonization.
• Control: He prioritizes proven technologies to safeguard his role as a stable contributor to the national infrastructure.

page3.subheading:
• Produces: Clinker & cement.
• Annual Production: 1.2 million tons of cement.
• Annual Revenue: SAR 250 million.
• Annual Emissions: 1,000,000 tons of CO_2 per year.

scenarios.question: The cement plant's emissions have increased significantly over the past year. Management knows that emissions are coming from fuel use, electricity consumption, and clinker production, but they do not know which source contributes the most or where to focus their investments. What should the plant do first to identify the biggest opportunities for carbon reduction?
scenarios.hint: The plant knows its emissions are coming from several areas, but not which one matters most. Before investing in any technology, first understand where the biggest opportunities for reduction actually are.

option1.name: Carbon Footprint Monitoring Systems
option1.description: Deploys digital monitoring systems that track real-time CO₂ emissions from fuel consumption, electricity use, and clinker production.

option2.name: Baseline Energy Audits
option2.description: Deploys digital monitoring systems that track real-time CO₂ emissions from fuel consumption, electricity use, and clinker production.

option3.name: Lifecycle Assessment (LCA) Tools
option3.description: Deploys digital monitoring systems that track real-time CO₂ emissions from fuel consumption, electricity use, and clinker production.
